scenarios.name: Toggle Explore from an expanded panel title menu

scenario_steps.name: the full 3D Model ribbon is at the top
the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned
the user right-clicks the lower Modify title
the user opens the "Show Panels" submenu
Explore is checked in the submenu
the Modify additional commands remain visible
the user selects Explore in the submenu
Explore is hidden and the ribbon panels reflow
the Modify additional command area closes
the user opens the Modify additional command area
the user right-clicks the lower Modify title
the user opens the "Show Panels" submenu
Explore is unchecked in the submenu
the user selects Explore in the submenu
Explore returns to the 3D Model ribbon
the Modify additional command area closes
